research_question: What is the effect of antioxidant therapy, compared with placebo, usual care, or no treatment, on cardiovascular death in adults with chronic kidney disease (CKD stages 3 to 5, dialysis, or kidney transplant)?
control_label: Placebo, usual care, or no treatment
outcome_description: Cardiovascular death (number of participants who died from cardiovascular causes over total participants randomised or analysed in each arm over the total follow-up period)
positive_direction: A lower risk of cardiovascular death in the antioxidant group compared to the control group (risk ratio < 1, favoring antioxidant therapy)
search_queries: antioxidant chronic kidney disease cardiovascular mortality trial
vitamin E N-acetylcysteine bardoxolone dialysis CKD cardiovascular death randomized
antioxidant therapy chronic kidney disease cardiovascular death controlled trial
inclusion_criteria: Randomized controlled trials evaluating antioxidant therapy (including vitamin E, N-acetylcysteine, selenium, bardoxolone methyl, pentoxifylline, or related agents) versus placebo, usual care, or no treatment
Adult participants (aged 18+) with chronic kidney disease (CKD stages 3 to 5, receiving maintenance dialysis, or kidney transplant recipients), including CKD subgroups of larger trials
Reporting the number of cardiovascular deaths and total participants in each trial arm over follow-up
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical randomized controlled trial (e.g., systematic reviews, meta-analyses, observational studies, editorials, animal studies, or protocols)
No comparison between antioxidant therapy and an inactive control (e.g., head-to-head trials comparing one antioxidant against another without a placebo/usual care group)
No extractable quantitative data on cardiovascular deaths for each treatment arm, or reporting only composite endpoints/all-cause deaths without distinct cardiovascular death counts
Studies conducted in populations without chronic kidney disease or completely unrelated to the research topic
moderators_to_extract: CKD stage or modality (non-dialysis CKD stages 3-5 vs. dialysis vs. kidney transplant)
Antioxidant agent or class (e.g., vitamin E, N-acetylcysteine, bardoxolone methyl, pentoxifylline, multi-antioxidant)
Control condition type (placebo vs. usual care or no treatment)
Baseline cardiovascular disease history or risk level
effect_size_note: Risk ratio (RR) pooled under a random-effects model. Only explicit cardiovascular death counts and denominators are extracted; composite endpoints, non-fatal events, and unverified all-cause mortality are excluded. Multi-arm antioxidant dosing groups are combined into a single intervention group.
